question: Who was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) in March 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Ajay Bhadoo**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Ajay Bhadoo** was appointed as the **Chief Executive Officer (CEO)** of the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)** in **March 2025**. • The **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)** is an online platform developed to facilitate the procurement of goods and services by government departments, organizations, and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). • Ajay Bhadoo is a senior Indian Administrative Service (**IAS**) officer known for his contributions to public administration and governance. • His appointment to this significant role aligns with the government’s aim to enhance the efficiency and transparency of public procurement through the GeM platform. • GeM is a flagship initiative under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** and plays a critical role in streamlining government procurement processes.
